AUTHOR: Jahanbakht
TITLE: Semi-supervised and weakly-supervised deep neural networks and dataset for fish detection in turbid underwater videos
REGION: Port of Mackay, Queensland, Australia (two geolocations)
SPECIES: Fish presence/absence per frame; species not identified
DATA: Own FishInTurbidWater dataset: 15-camera drop array, 60-min MP4 per camera per drop, 1,800 min of video weakly labelled (fish / no-fish per frame); 30% carefully relabelled as validation set
V_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'the turbidity level during this period was variable between 1 and 105 NTU. More than 66% of the time, this NTU level is greater than 5.0' (Fig. 3); performance not stratified by turbidity
D2: 70% weakly labelled training / 30% carefully labelled validation; contrastive model fine-tuned on 20% of training data; split unit not stated
D_EV: Sec. 3: '30% of the whole FishInTurbidWater was carefully labeled manually to make a solid validation dataset' — whether split by frame, camera or drop is not stated
R_EV: Sec. 4: 'Despite not having access to a control clear water dataset to run our two proposed semi- and weakly-supervised methods on' — evaluated only on own dataset's validation split
C_EV: Decision threshold not reported; Sec. 3: 'AUC-ROC in this table is a performance measurement of a classifier against various probability thresholds' and 'AUC-ROC is not available for XGBoost'
E_EV: Table 1/2 report only accuracy, precision, F1, AUC-ROC; Sec. 4: 'low False Negative Rate (FNR) and False Positive Rate (FPR) of 0.11 and 0.01'; no abundance variable
ARCH: (1) Semi-supervised contrastive learning: ResNet-50 encoder + projection head, then frozen encoder + 129-neuron decoder; (2) Weakly-supervised ensemble: EfficientNet-B7 and ViT (ImageNet, last FC fine-tuned) merged by XGBoost decision-tree ensemble
METR: Accuracy, precision, F1-score, AUC-ROC, TPR/TNR/FNR/FPR (confusion matrix), turnaround time
NOTE: Also a dataset paper (FishInTurbidWater, publicly released) but coded TYPE = 검출 since the experiments are frame-level fish/no-fish classification. NTU values come from a long-term port water-quality monitoring program at the same geolocations (Fig. 3), not per-video measurements, and no performance stratification by NTU (V6 = N -> V_ALL = P). Split unit for the 70/30 training/validation partition is not stated (frames from the same 60-min videos may appear in both) -> D1 = NR. C3 = 없음 although an XGBoost ensemble of two DNNs is used: the ensemble is for accuracy, not uncertainty estimation; verifier may consider C3 = 앙상블 (which would make C_ALL = Y). PLAT: drop camera array lowered from a boat (not fixed observatory, not baited) — coded 고정 카메라/관측소 as nearest category. ENV: turbid port/coastal waters — coded 하구/기수. Frame counts not reported (NIMG = null).
